item.title: Trump says U.S. struck Kharg Island, core of Iran’s oil economy
item.summary: The strikes destroyed more than 90 military targets, including missile facilities, but preserved oil infrastructure, U.S. Central Command said Saturday.

item.title: Trump urged uprising, but as bombs fall, Iranians are ‘too scared to move’
item.summary: Some Iranians living in Dubai say their families celebrated the death of the supreme leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, but the war could leave Iran in a worse situation than before.

item.title: How Trump suspending sanctions on Russian oil helps Putin’s war effort
item.summary: The Kremlin hopes the Trump administration’s move to contain oil prices sent soaring by the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran will lead to further relief.

item.title: Hegseth vows thorough probe of school strike that Trump blamed on Iran
item.summary: The announcement appeared to tacitly acknowledge a growing body of evidence that U.S. forces, not Iran, were responsible for the deadly attack.

item.title: Cuba acknowledges secret meetings with U.S. as Trump dials up threats
item.summary: Trump has warned that Cuba is next in line after Venezuela and Iran, saying that the Havana regime is in its “last moments of life.”

item.title: 6 dead after U.S. Air Force refueler crashes in Iraq while supporting Iran war
item.summary: The KC-135 tanker was involved in an apparent accident with another KC-135. The other aircraft landed safely, officials said.

item.title: Trump administration allows for Russian oil sales as energy prices soar
item.summary: The move is likely to be a boon to Russia as the United States tries to stem the economic fallout from its war on Iran as the price of crude has soared.

item.title: Unpopular war makes friendship with Trump a liability for European leaders
item.summary: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni and a constellation of other conservative leaders are the defensive over their ties to President Trump because of his war against Iran.

item.title: What Earth’s longest-lived animals can teach us about aging better
item.summary: Inside the growing scientific quest to understand what creatures with the extraordinary ability to defy the ravages of time can teach us about making human aging better.

item.title: They came to build China’s EV future. Investigators found conditions akin to ‘slavery.’
item.summary: Few Chinese laborers have spoken out about the abuses they allegedly suffered while toiling abroad. Until now.
